sample_unit: physician reviews of agent-drafted handoff briefs (84 briefs)

links.outcome: Physician-adjudicated claim accuracy, omissions, and quality of AI-drafted ICU handoff briefs
links.effect: 98.8% of adjudicable claims verified and 1.2% incorrect; 88% of briefs had no pertinent omission; mean PDSQI-9 quality 4.20/5.
links.quote: Among adjudicable claims, 98.8% were verified and 1.2% were incorrect; 88% of briefs had no pertinent omission, and mean PDSQI-9 quality was 4.20/5.

unlisted_practices: Role-specialized multi-agent pipeline mirroring ICU team structure
Explicit surfacing of conflicting documentation before synthesis
Deterministic safety checks on extracted data before synthesis
LLM-as-judge (o4-mini PDSQI-9) for aggregate quality monitoring

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of a clinician-in-the-loop multi-agent LLM pipeline with explicit conflict surfacing and safety checks for ICU handoff briefs, evaluated by 5 physicians on retrospective cohort records.

primary.practice: clinician-in-the-loop review and deterministic safety checks / conflict surfacing
